2607.10582.title: MemDecay: Region-Aware KV Cache Eviction for Efficient LLM Agent Inference
2607.10582.method: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10582v1#S3.SS2 — structural priors; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10582v1#S3.SS3 — calibrated region decay and attention refresh; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10582v1#S3.SS4 — page-granularity eviction; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10582v1#S3.SS5 — scope and tiered extension
2607.10582.evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10582v1#S4.SS1 — setup; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10582v1#S4.SS2 — lifetime measurement; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10582v1#S4.SS3 — budgeted recall; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10582v1#S4.SS4 — sensitivity and overhead
2607.10582.limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10582v1#S5 — discussion, negative results and limitations
2607.10582.delta: An Agent orchestrator supplies typed semantic region labels and explicit pinning policy; the inference runtime combines those priors with calibrated decay and observed attention to make page-level KV eviction decisions.
2607.10582.source_claim: The paper supports region-dependent attention lifetimes, interpretable pinned retention and its synthetic budgeted-recall/overhead results. It also reports that the unnormalized attention term was much smaller than the structural term and that accumulated-attention retention beat MemDecay on unpinned recall at larger scale. It does not prove production long-context Agent quality or tail-SLO gains.
2607.10582.analysis_old: FullKV is the correctness baseline; recency/window and accumulated-attention policies are simpler when semantic labels are unavailable or unreliable. Agent traces change the constraint because the orchestrator already knows which spans are instructions, plans, tool outputs or scratch state.
2607.10582.analysis_tradeoff: Semantic labels and pinning make retention policy inspectable but convert orchestrator labeling errors into irreversible runtime deletion. Attention observation and eager-attention access add overhead; page means can dilute boundary regions; offload/recompute remain safer when future utility is uncertain.
2607.10582.integration_section: Ch45 / 从统一保留到 workload-aware eviction / add Agent semantic-lifetime branch after Pre-RoPE and workload-semantic selection

2607.10599.title: MRUF: Multi-granularity Routing with Uncertainty-Aware Fusion for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
2607.10599.method: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10599v1#S3.SS2 — modality-invariant alignment; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10599v1#S3.SS3 — multi-granularity routing and leave-one-out supervision; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10599v1#S3.SS4 — inverse-variance uncertainty-aware fusion; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10599v1#S3.SS5 — prediction and training objective
2607.10599.evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10599v1#S4.SS1 — datasets; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10599v1#S4.SS3 — implementation; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10599v1#S4.SS4 — efficiency; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10599v1#S4.SS6 — ablations; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10599v1#S4.SS7 — controlled perturbations; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10599v1#S4.SS8 — uncertainty/gate mechanism analysis
2607.10599.limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10599v1#S4.SS7 — severe perturbation does not always improve MAE; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10599v1#S5 — training-cost and future-work boundary
2607.10599.artifact: Not Disclosed — exact v1 links no author repository, immutable implementation or checkpoint
2607.10599.delta: Separate task contribution from observation reliability: a contribution router is supervised by leave-one-out task degradation, while a distinct uncertainty head predicts modality-wise log variance and inverse-variance weights calibrate the final fusion gate.
2607.10599.source_claim: The source supports this mechanism and its MOSI/MOSEI author experiments, ablations and perturbation tests. Predicted uncertainty is a learned reliability sensor, not a probability that a modality is true, and the results do not establish broad multimodal robustness or production behavior.
2607.10599.analysis_old: Static, symmetric or task-contribution-only fusion is reasonable when modality quality is stable. Once occlusion, noise, missing inputs or transcript error vary per utterance, contribution and current reliability become distinct control signals.
2607.10599.analysis_tradeoff: Leave-one-out supervision adds masked forwards during training; uncertainty calibration adds a learned sensor whose correlations and distribution shift can be wrong. Inference remains one forward pass in the paper, but severe perturbations did not always improve regression MAE. Static or single-modality branches remain preferable when inputs are reliable, training budget is tight or calibration evidence is weak.

2607.10709.title: PromptGraph: Graph-Guided Prompt Sanitization for Balancing Privacy and Utility in LLM Inference
2607.10709.method: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10709v1#S3.SS2 — threat model; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10709v1#S4.SS2 — direct and contextual privacy scoring; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10709v1#S4.SS3 — pairwise utility dependency; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10709v1#S4.SS4 — constrained sanitization; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10709v1#S4.SS5 — local restoration
2607.10709.evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10709v1#S5.SS1 — setup, models, datasets, baselines and metrics; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10709v1#S5.SS2 — privacy/utility results, attacks, ablations, sensitivity and overhead
2607.10709.limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10709v1#S3.SS2 — honest-but-curious single-turn threat model; https://arxiv.org/html/2607.10709v1#S6 — multi-turn extension remains future work
2607.10709.artifact: Not Disclosed — exact v1 links no author implementation; the CodeAlpaca GitHub citation is a dataset source, not PromptGraph provenance
2607.10709.delta: Move prompt privacy from independent PII-span masking to a client-owned graph that estimates contextual attribute leakage and pairwise utility dependencies, selects a privacy/utility cut, sends opaque placeholders, and restores only exact consistency-checked identifiers locally.
2607.10709.source_claim: The paper supports this single-turn honest-but-curious design and its MedQA/SAMSum/CodeAlpaca author experiments. It does not prove Differential Privacy, anonymity, compliance, adaptive-attacker resistance or production latency, and it does not disclose the exact local estimator, hardware or precision.
2607.10709.analysis_old: Regex and NER masking remain correct for explicit structured identifiers and low latency. Learned independent-span policies become insufficient when non-sensitive cues jointly reveal an attribute or when masking destroys relations required by the downstream task.
2607.10709.analysis_tradeoff: Relation-aware selection improves the measured privacy/utility frontier but depends on local detectors, attribute estimators, reconstruction proxies and sparse graph coverage. Greedy selection is approximate, placeholders can alter model behavior, and restoration must fail closed rather than granting the cloud model authority over private state.
2607.10709.integration_section: Ch72 / 隐私检测是 Policy-bound Sensor，不是安全判决 / add relation-aware local sanitization after learned anonymization and before Differential Privacy

closure_reviews.title: Implicit Fine-tuning via Context Engineering: A Curriculum Learning Framework for Multimodal Entity Alignment
closure_reviews.evidence_level: Exact arXiv v1 identity/date and topic-level rejection closure; no mechanism or benchmark claim retained
closure_reviews.disposition: Rejected — Low Durability / Out of Scope
closure_reviews.reason: The task-specific MMEA curriculum-prompt method and its simplified one-layer equivalence do not establish a durable cross-system mechanism. Exact full text was inspected during preaudit, but no benchmark or mechanism claim is retained by the canonical closure receipt.

family_reviews.books_disposition: Rejected — Low Durability / Out of Scope
family_reviews.closure_reason: Exact v1 and event-time code identity are available, but the retained proposition is a narrow MMEA curriculum-prompt method. The paper's equivalence relies on a simplified single attention layer, a constructed dual model and a one-step gradient analogy; it is not a general equivalence between context engineering and model parameter training.

family_reviews.problem: Generic KV policies ignore the semantic lifetimes already known to an Agent orchestrator.
family_reviews.mechanism: Typed contiguous regions, base priorities, calibrated decay, attention refresh, explicit pinning and page-mean eviction.
family_reviews.state_ownership: The orchestrator owns semantic labels and pin authority; the runtime owns exact KV/page state, attention observations and irreversible eviction.
family_reviews.proof_and_nonproof: Controlled author experiments support lifetime heterogeneity and a semantic-prior branch, but negative unpinned recall and attention-overhead results prevent a universal superiority claim.
family_reviews.coexistence_boundary: FullKV, recency/attention policies and recoverable tiering remain valid when labels are weak, Context is short, memory is available or deletion risk dominates.

family_reviews.problem: A modality may be useful in general but unreliable for the current sample; one gate should not conflate contribution and reliability.
family_reviews.mechanism: Leave-one-out task degradation supervises contribution routing; a separate log-variance head produces inverse-variance reliability weights; both multiply into the final gate.
family_reviews.state_ownership: The representation/fusion owner maintains contribution and reliability sensors; the downstream task head consumes the fused state. Predicted variance is not truth authority.
family_reviews.proof_and_nonproof: MOSI/MOSEI experiments, ablations and controlled perturbations support feasibility and sensor-gate correlation. They do not prove calibrated probabilities, causal modality truth, broad multimodal transfer or production SLO.
family_reviews.coexistence_boundary: Static or contribution-only fusion remains simpler when modality quality is stable, calibration labels are unavailable or training cost dominates.

family_reviews.problem: Explicit PII masking misses contextual leakage while indiscriminate masking destroys downstream utility.
family_reviews.mechanism: Client-side node privacy and pairwise utility graph, greedy privacy-gain/utility-loss selection, opaque placeholders and exact consistency-gated restoration.
family_reviews.state_ownership: The client exclusively owns original spans, policy, graph and restoration map. The cloud output cannot authorize restoration.
family_reviews.proof_and_nonproof: Author experiments support the reported single-turn honest-but-curious contract. They do not establish DP, compliance, adaptive-attacker resistance or multi-turn privacy.
family_reviews.coexistence_boundary: Regex/NER remains preferable for strong formats and low latency; DP is a separate mathematical release boundary, not a stronger version of this sanitizer.
